cases.note: file-existence gate: mod/SummonAnywhere/ModEntry.cs exists and the tree has no symlink; the starter already satisfies it

cases.id: case:setup: the player owns a horse and carries a horse flute
case:sentinel: the flute still summons the horse outdoors
cases.note: base-game behaviour that holds with the empty skeleton mod (P in starter.execution.json) and is stated as a must-keep in the exam; a mod can break it (control cn-toggles-indoors-flag), so it is a real preserved contract, not only a runtime sentinel

cases.id: case:the flute summons the horse indoors
cases.note: SuiteSummon.cs:159-160 asserts, before the flute is used, that the horse is not already in the farmhouse; that precondition is the only evidence for Keep-3

clauses.anchor: Requirement, paragraph 2: 'make using the horse flute summon the player's horse to the player's current location even when that location is indoors'
clauses.note: exercised in the FarmHouse only; sheds, caves and the mines named in paragraph 1 are not

clauses.anchor: Requirement, paragraph 2, last clause: 'bringing the horse next to the player the same way it does outdoors'
clauses.note: indoors the suite only asserts that the horse is in the farmhouse's character list (SuiteSummon.cs:165-169); the 3-tile proximity check exists only in the outdoor case (:144-146)

clauses.anchor: Requirement, bullet 1: 'Using the flute outdoors must behave as it always has.'
clauses.note: one summon on the Farm, horse within 3 tiles; error messages and the refusal paths outdoors are not checked

clauses.anchor: Requirement, bullet 2: 'The other conditions the game places on summoning a horse still apply — you are removing the indoor restriction specifically'
clauses.note: no case uses the flute without standing room, without an owned horse or while the horse is in use; the fixture deliberately moves the player to a tile where NoRoom is clear (SuiteSummon.cs:64-77, called at :122 and :158). A mod that clears every restriction passes.

clauses.anchor: Requirement, bullet 3: 'The mod must not summon a horse on its own; it happens when the flute is used.'
clauses.note: only the single precondition assertion at SuiteSummon.cs:159-160, evaluated once right after the warp into the farmhouse

clauses.anchor: Notes, bullet 3: 'Keep the manifest's UniqueID and EntryDll as they are'
clauses.note: delivery constraint with no case of its own: tests/test.sh copies SummonAnywhere.dll and manifest.json, so a changed EntryDll only shows up as the mod not loading; UniqueID is never read

clauses.anchor: Notes, bullet 4: 'Do not modify anything under /tests.'
clauses.note: no case; the evaluator mounts /tests read-only

known_issues: Entry-point over-constraint: the suite fires the flute by calling Object.performUseAction on a fresh flute object (benchmarks/stardew-core/private/harbor/stardew-summon-horse-anywhere/tests/SuiteSummon.cs:129, :162), never through player input. A mod that implements the requirement at the input layer (for example a SMAPI ButtonPressed handler that performs the indoor summon when the held item is the flute) works for a player but is invisible to the harness and fails the target case. The exam only says the harness 'uses the flute'.

Keep-2 is unasserted: probe-clears-every-restriction (the reference changed to report HorseWarpRestrictions.None unconditionally; row kept in probes.tsv) was run in the real game and passes 3/3 with score 100. Keep-2 is excluded from the scored contract sets.
The indoor case does not check where in the room the horse ends up, and only the FarmHouse is exercised.
The preserved case is base-game behaviour. It passes on the empty starter, so the task has exactly one preserved contract and its violation needs an active change by the mod.

The prepared evaluator image used for the E0 runs (sha256:e205728d1222) bakes /opt/gcb/harness with the SuiteRunner that predates commit 276a070: there a throwing wait predicate is treated as SATISFIED instead of failing the case (repo version: benchmarks/stardew-core/private/harbor/harness/GcbHarness/Framework/SuiteRunner.cs:80-95). Predicates that can throw in this suite: the horse lookups `FindPlayerHorse(Game1.currentLocation)` (SuiteSummon.cs:136, :166) throw when Game1.currentLocation is null. In each of them the statement after the wait dereferences the same null object, so the case still fails under the old runner; no spurious pass was found.
